overall: The AG found no violation: the Committee did not create a subcommittee, because two members volunteering on their own initiative to work with the NRC did not form a public body under the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee created a two-member subcommittee to develop Hunnewell field lighting plans that posted no notice, kept no minutes, and met privately.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that the Committee itself created a subcommittee that is subject to the Open Meeting Law.
